question_text: What is the Elderline toll-free helpline number in India, and on which days and at what times can senior citizens call it?
expected_answer_facts: Toll-free number 14567
Operates 7 days a week from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM

question_text: When was India's Elderline helpline launched, and which international observance marked the occasion?
expected_answer_facts: Dedicated or launched on 1 October 2021
International Day for Older Persons

question_text: What health coverage is provided under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY for citizens aged 70 and above, and does income affect eligibility?
expected_answer_facts: Health coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh per family per year
Covers secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation
Applies to all citizens aged 70 years and above irrespective of socio-economic status

question_text: Which telemedicine platform offers free home-based medical consultations for elderly people, including those with chronic conditions?
expected_answer_facts: e-Sanjeevani telemedicine platform under NPHCE
Provides free home-based medical consultations for chronic conditions

question_text: Which ministry implements the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme, and under which government programme does it operate?
expected_answer_facts: Implemented under National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
Implemented by Ministry of Rural Development

question_text: What guaranteed monthly pension amounts can subscribers receive under Atal Pension Yojana after turning 60?
expected_answer_facts: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1,000, Rs. 2,000, Rs. 3,000, Rs. 4,000, or Rs. 5,000
Payable after age 60 years

question_text: Under the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, are daughters responsible for maintaining their parents just like sons?
expected_answer_facts: Both sons and daughters (including daughters-in-law and sons-in-law) are equally liable for maintenance under the Act

question_text: What NALSA scheme provides free legal assistance to senior citizens, and where can they receive these services?
expected_answer_facts: NALSA Legal Services to Senior Citizens Scheme, 2016
Offers free legal aid and legal service clinics at tribunals and old age homes

question_text: Which organization implements Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana, and when was the scheme launched?
expected_answer_facts: Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation (ALIMCO) is the sole implementing agency
Launched on 1 April 2017

question_text: What special counter facilities does RBI advise banks to provide for senior citizens and persons with disabilities?
expected_answer_facts: Banks advised to provide a clearly identifiable dedicated or priority counter for senior citizens and differently abled persons

question_text: If a family is already covered under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, what additional health coverage is available for members aged 70 or above, and is it separate from the coverage for younger family members?
expected_answer_facts: Additional top-up cover of up to Rs. 5 lakh per year
Exclusive to senior citizens aged 70 years and above in families already covered under AB PM-JAY
Separate from cover available to family members below 70 years

question_text: Under EPS-95, what are the minimum service requirement, wage ceiling, employer and government contribution rates, and earliest age for a reduced pension?
expected_answer_facts: Minimum 10 years of eligible service (disability pension available without 10 years)
Wage ceiling Rs. 15,000 per month
Employer contributes 8.33% and Central Government contributes 1.16%
Reduced pension available from age 50

question_text: Who can enroll in Atal Pension Yojana in terms of age and citizenship, and are current or former income-taxpayers eligible?
expected_answer_facts: Open to all Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years
Excludes those who are or have been income tax payers

question_text: What are the BPL and monthly income eligibility criteria for Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana, which documents are required, and what special delivery facility is available for people aged 80 or above?
expected_answer_facts: BPL senior citizens with monthly income not more than Rs. 15,000
Devices provided at doorsteps for senior citizens aged 80 years or more
Mandatory documents include Aadhaar card and Income Certificate

question_text: Under the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens, what assistance is provided to organizations running elderly homes, how many residents can the homes accommodate, and which facilities are free?
expected_answer_facts: Grant-in-aid provided to NGOs/VOs
Senior Citizens' Home for 25 senior citizens or Senior Citizens' Homes for Women for 50 elderly women
Food, shelter, care/medicare, and recreation facilities provided free of cost

question_text: My elderly uncle is being neglected at home, and we're worried about his safety. Is there a free helpline that can help him, what kind of support does it provide, and when can we call?
expected_answer_facts: Call toll-free 14567 (8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, all seven days)
Provides field intervention, care and support for abused elderly, legal/dispute resolution, and emotional support

question_text: My grandfather's children aren't helping him financially, and he can't afford a lawyer. Are his children legally responsible for supporting him, and where can he get free legal help?
expected_answer_facts: Sons and daughters are equally liable for maintenance under the MWPSC Act, 2007
District Magistrate has powers and duties under Section 22 to ensure implementation
NALSA Legal Services to Senior Citizens Scheme, 2016 offers free legal aid

question_text: My father is a pensioner and finds it difficult to visit the bank. Can we complete his life certificate digitally, and what details and biometric verification would he need?
expected_answer_facts: Biometric-enabled Aadhaar authentication (fingerprint or iris)
Requires Aadhaar number, Pension Payment Order, bank account, bank name, and mobile number
Available via PC/mobile application or Jeevan Pramaan Centre

question_text: My mother is 65, and her bank is deducting TDS from her fixed-deposit interest even though her total income is low. Is there a form she can submit to avoid eligible deductions?
expected_answer_facts: Form 15H is the declaration for a resident individual aged 60 years or more
Used to claim eligible receipts without TDS deduction when estimated tax liability on total income for the relevant financial year is nil, subject to applicable conditions

question_text: My father recently retired and wants to stay active by doing some work. Is there a government programme that connects experienced senior citizens with companies?
expected_answer_facts: Senior Citizen Opportunities for Productive Engagement (SCOPE) portal
Brings experienced senior citizens and private enterprises together by virtual matching of preferences

What percentage discount does Indian Railways currently offer senior citizens on train tickets?
Does Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY cover dental implants or cosmetic dental procedures for people aged 70 and above?
What exact municipal property-tax discount and passport application fee concession are available to senior citizens in India?
